balance_requirements.exact_pair_rule: A and B load the same frozen float64 simulator state, use the same geometry, rendering, robot state, probe order, and controller; only body mass/inertia factors differ. First RGB hashes must match exactly.

mass_intervention_test.paired_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval for the mean of 16 exact-pair contrasts
mass_intervention_test.zero_differences: discard only for the exact sign test and report count

position_lane_order_adjustment.model: OLS on the 16 pair contrasts with centered initial back x, centered initial back y, centered initial back lane margin, probe-order indicator, and three spatial-stratum indicators
position_lane_order_adjustment.pairing_note: exact swapping already blocks every base-state fixed nuisance
position_lane_order_adjustment.required: positive intercept and lower interval endpoint > 0

precontact_and_position_controls.precontact_rgb_assignment_contrast: must be exactly zero for hash and stored localization fields

near_miss_replication.eligible_only_if: no collision, identity swap, leakage, missing row, or protocol violation and exactly one numerical signal gate misses by no more than one scene or two probes
near_miss_replication.replication: one independently frozen fresh identical panel that must independently pass every gate

primary_score.back_response_definition: max(0, max_t e_x^T T_back (delta_pixel_t - median(delta_pixel over the three immediately preceding stored steps)))
primary_score.name: original_back_slot_rgb_response_threshold_score
primary_score.rationale: This exactly reconstructs the original 22/24 frozen near-pass from raw observation-derived traces, uses the original response window, introduces no panel-derived threshold, and is simpler than a new model.
primary_score.response_window: exact five consecutive stored control steps whose phase is fixed_micro_impulse or post_impulse_response

safety_definitions.collision: any candidate-pair or candidate-distractor contact; intended paddle-candidate contact is not a collision
safety_definitions.fall: either candidate center z < 0.85 m at any stored step
safety_definitions.identity_swap: front or back body crosses into the other candidate's frozen lane or their x ordering reverses
safety_definitions.unrecoverable_track_loss: initial localization or any response-window tracker quality below 0.50, or a non-finite observation-derived response
safety_definitions.workspace_exit: either candidate center leaves x [-0.25,0.25], y [-0.05,0.25], z [0.85,1.10] m

manifest.sham_action: hold at the original high-clearance approach-start pose; apply the identical three +x action=0.65 steps and two zero-action response steps without entering the guarded contact approach
